# ui-model-complexity

Model names sorted by plain-language estimated work complexity.

- **Runs in:** the UI (your Emacs)
- **Source:** [lisp/ui/harness-ui-model-complexity.el](../../lisp/ui/harness-ui-model-complexity.el)
- **Loaded:** when enabled (see `harness-enable-modules`)
- **Requires:** [ui](ui.md)
- **Brings along:** [model-complexity](model-complexity.md) (the rest of it)

## About

Optional UI half of model-complexity.  The guide and the session/task
model picker show the same low-to-high estimated work levels.  Real
model names and ids stay intact; choosing a model still goes through
the usual handoff checks.  Nothing is selected merely by opening the
guide, and unknown models are explicitly Unrated, after ranked ones.

The backend supplies the rules and their explanations over ACP, so
this UI also works with a remote harness.  No provider code or model
routing heuristic runs here.  If that harness lacks the optional
method, the normal model picker remains usable.

## Provides

### Commands

- `harness-model-complexity` — Show available model names from low to high estimated work complexity.
- `harness-ui-model-complexity-copy-id` — Copy the real model id at point, without changing any session.
- `harness-ui-model-complexity-refresh` — Refresh the model complexity guide from the connected harness.

## Uses

### Methods it calls

- `model-complexity/list` ([model-complexity](model-complexity.md))

### Hooks it adds to

- `harness-ui-model-picker-functions` → `harness-ui-model-complexity--pick`
